instructions: This part is about you, not your child. Think about yourself over the past month. For each moment, pick the ONE answer that sounds most like you right now, even if more than one fits. There are no wrong answers: every choice is a strength.
frequency_stem: In the past month, how often do you...

scenarios.prompt: A free hour all to yourself. You are most likely to...

options.text: read, or write something: a letter, a blog, a story
plan, budget, or work on a puzzle
rearrange a room, sketch, or plan how a space could look

scenarios.prompt: At a church event, you are happiest...

options.text: in the kitchen or setting up, with your hands busy
singing, or helping with the music
greeting people and making new families feel at home

scenarios.prompt: On a walk by yourself, you...

options.text: sort through your own thoughts and plans
notice the birds, the plants and the weather changing
think about life's big questions and God's purposes

scenarios.prompt: When you have a problem to work out, you...

options.text: talk it through, or write it all down

scenarios.prompt: Planning a family celebration, the part you love most is...

options.text: how it looks: the table, the colors, the decorations

what it means: the story or the blessing behind it

scenarios.prompt: In your quiet time with the Lord, you are most drawn to...

options.text: reading, and the words of Scripture themselves
worship music, hymns, or singing

scenarios.prompt: When you volunteer, you would rather...

options.text: run the schedule, the sign-ups or the money

take a task you can do quietly on your own

scenarios.prompt: With a free Saturday, you would most enjoy...

options.text: a design project: a room makeover, a photo album, a sketch
building, sewing, baking, or fixing something
working in the garden or caring for animals

scenarios.prompt: With friends, you are usually the one who...

options.text: tells the stories that get everyone laughing
remembers what everyone is going through and checks in
suggests getting outside: a hike, a farm, the park

scenarios.prompt: Starting something new, like a homeschool year, you...

options.text: make the plan, the calendar and the lists first
dive in and figure it out by doing
start with why: who you hope your children become

scenarios.prompt: When you need to recharge, you...

options.text: make something beautiful: arrange, draw, or decorate
put on music, or play or sing
get time alone to think, journal or reflect
